key_insight: Targeted fine-tuning of a MACE atomistic foundation model improves Na–C energetics and links smaller closed pores in hard carbon to higher sodium-storage plateau voltages.
engineering_relevance: The model could guide hard-carbon pore design for Na-ion batteries by connecting local atomic structure with storage voltage.
method: Evaluate pretrained MACE models across diverse local Na/C motifs.
Fine-tune to recover DFT-level energetics for competing bonding environments.
Use the fine-tuned model to relate closed-pore radius to plateau voltage.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports pretrained-model failures for Na–Na and Na–C interactions in metallic Na clusters on graphene, followed by improved motif energetics and transferability to unseen Na/C environments after fine-tuning.
watch_item: The abstract provides no numerical error metrics or validation scope, so reliability across broader hard-carbon structures remains to be established.
paper_title: Fine-tuned atomistic foundation model for accurate sodium-carbon chemistry in Na-ion batteries
